title: Nuclear silo shutdowns and anti-nuclear messaging
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Nuclear silo shutdowns and anti-nuclear messaging, about unspecified at nuclear missile silos, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: lot of a lot of the nuclear stuff is like shutting down silos and maybe and then a lot of the messaging that people get seems to be like you're going to destroy yourselves in some sort of nuclear holocaust

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on the work of researcher Robert Hastings, says many UFO accounts tied to nuclear weapons involve missile silos, the underground launch sites, being shut down. He adds that the messages people say they receive often warn that humanity will destroy itself in a nuclear holocaust. If true, it would suggest whatever is behind these events cares about our nuclear weapons.
